name: spell-card
title: Spell Card
description: Light-DOM presentational card for a D&D spell: school colour band, ornamental gold corners, level/cantrip badge, school eyebrow, name heading, ritual/concentration tags, a casting-time/range/components/duration meta grid (dl/dt/dd), italic description, optional "At Higher Levels" and footer zones. Eight spell-school colour modifiers. role=article with an aria-label woven from the spell name; tabbable with a focus-visible ring.
